tools.name: fintech_schedule-risk-audit
tools.description: Stress-test a caller-supplied loan schedule, cashflow stream, and payout list. Inflows move 7, 14, and 30 days later, outflows stay on their dates, and financing cost uses the supplied annual rate. The math stays in memory. This is not a credit decision. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fintech/schedu

tools.name: fintech_repayment-waterfall-simulate
tools.description: Allocate available cash across caller-supplied debt facilities by contractual priority and bucket order (fees, arrears, interest, principal). tools.name: fintech_covenant-headroom-calculate
tools.description: Compute headroom for caller-supplied financial covenants against metric values and thresholds. Returns the exact threshold, headroom formula, and breach status. No credit bureau is contacted. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/fintech/covenant-headroom-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "fintech" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fintech_schedule-risk-audit · Public sink: fintech_schedule-risk-audit, fintech_repayment-waterfall-simulate, fintech_covenant-headroom-calculate, fintech_receivables-dilution-analyze · Destructive: fintech_schedule-risk-audit, fintech_repayment-waterfall-simulate, fintech_covenant-headroom-calculate, fintech_receivables-dilution-analyze.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fintech_schedule-risk-audit · Public sink: fintech_schedule-risk-audit, fintech_repayment-waterfall-simulate, fintech_covenant-headroom-calculate, fintech_receivables-dilution-analyze · Destructive: fintech_schedule-risk-audit, fintech_repayment-waterfall-simulate, fintech_covenant-headroom-calculate, fintech_receivables-dilution-analyze

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
